stories.title: México es humillado por Estados Unidos en el Clásico de Concacaf; Rafa Márquez sigue sin conocer la victoria

en.title: Mexico is humiliated by United States in Concacaf Classic; Rafa Márquez remains winless
en.summary: Mexico's national team suffered a significant defeat to the United States in a Concacaf Classic match at State Farm Stadium in Glendale, with defensive errors in both penalty areas proving costly for coach Rafa Márquez.

stories.title: SNTE anuncia acciones conjuntas con el Gobierno de México para fortalecer seguridad en las escuelas

en.title: SNTE announces joint actions with Mexican Government to strengthen school security
en.summary: Mexico's national teachers union announced coordinated efforts with the government to enhance security in schools, while reiterating union demands for reforms to the ISSSTE pension law.

stories.title: Capacitará SNTE con Fuerzas Armadas ante ataques escolares

en.title: SNTE to provide training with Armed Forces in response to school attacks
en.summary: Following recent attacks on schools, the teachers union and Armed Forces will conduct training for parents, teachers, and students on how to respond to dangerous situations in educational facilities.

stories.title: "El Chucky" Lozano queda fuera del amistoso contra Estados Unidos

en.title: "Chucky" Lozano ruled out of friendly against United States
en.summary: Mexican footballer Hirving Lozano has been excluded from tonight's friendly match against the United States and will leave the team's training camp tomorrow.

stories.title: Rafa Márquez sorprende con el 11 titular frente a Estados Unidos; esta es la alineación de México

en.title: Rafa Márquez surprises with starting lineup against United States; this is Mexico's formation
en.summary: Mexico's coach Rafa Márquez announced his starting eleven for a match against the United States, with forward Hirving Lozano unavailable due to hamstring issues.

stories.title: Riqueza cultural y cosmovisión maya de Quintana Roo llegan al Complejo Cultural Los Pinos; buscan acercar al público las tradiciones y sabores

en.title: Mayan cultural wealth and worldview from Quintana Roo arrive at Los Pinos Cultural Complex; seeking to bring traditions and flavors closer to the public
en.summary: Governor Mara Lezama inaugurated an exhibition in Mexico City showcasing the identity, knowledge, and traditions of communities from Quintana Roo.

stories.title: Tras ataque en Torreón, Fuerzas Armadas capacitarán a escuelas en seguridad; SNTE llama a prevenir violencia

en.title: After attack in Torreón, Armed Forces will train schools in security; SNTE calls to prevent violence
en.summary: Following an attack in Torreón, Mexico's Armed Forces plan to conduct security training sessions in schools in coming weeks, with teacher union officials urging violence prevention.

stories.title: Estados Unidos 2-0 México EN VIVO; sigue aquí el minuto a minuto del partido amistoso

en.title: United States 2-0 Mexico LIVE; follow here the minute-by-minute of the friendly match
en.summary: The United States defeated Mexico 2-0 in a friendly soccer match.

stories.title: Quintana Roo comparte con orgullo su cultura viva y cosmovisión maya en Los Pinos

en.title: Quintana Roo proudly shares its living culture and Mayan worldview in Los Pinos
en.summary: Mara Lezama opened an exhibition in Mexico City on October 3-4 featuring Quintana Roo's cultural heritage, with free admission to see local producers, artisans, cooks, musicians and artists showcase the state's traditions.

stories.title: Tras ataque en Torreón: ¿qué dicen los datos sobre violencia y salud mental entre adolescentes?

en.title: After attack in Torreón: what do data say about violence and mental health among adolescents?
en.summary: Recent studies indicate Mexican adolescents face psychological distress, self-harm, bullying and violence exposure, while schools struggle to provide adequate emotional support services.

stories.title: Estados Unidos despliega 500 militares en frontera con México; Marina activa operativo en Matamoros

en.title: United States deploys 500 military personnel on Mexico border; Navy activates operation in Matamoros
en.summary: The United States has deployed 500 military personnel to its border with Mexico as part of coordinated mirror operations between the two countries. Mexico has positioned 159 naval personnel, 11 vehicles, and two drones in the border zone.

stories.title: Elton John da cátedra de cómo desafiar al tiempo; el cantante se despide de México

en.title: Elton John teaches how to defy time; the singer says goodbye to Mexico
en.summary: Singer Elton John bids farewell to Mexico following a performance that demonstrates his ability to overcome the effects of aging.

stories.title: México vs. Estados Unidos: así está el marcador económico entre los dos países

en.title: Mexico vs. United States: here's the economic scoreboard between the two countries
en.summary: Mexico and the United States maintain a commercial relationship exceeding 870 billion dollars, running parallel to a soccer match between their national teams.

stories.title: Un avión desaparece frente a la costa este de Estados Unidos

en.title: A plane disappears off the east coast of the United States
en.summary: A medical evacuation aircraft carrying six people vanished off the coast of Massachusetts while traveling from Bermuda to Boston.

stories.title: Lula da Silva y Flávio Bolsonaro se preparan para las elecciones en Brasil

en.title: Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro prepare for elections in Brazil
en.summary: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are concluding their election campaigns in Brazil, with polls indicating a runoff scheduled for October 25 and Trump's influence emerging as a key debate topic.

stories.title: El Brasil que viene: mercados, inversiones y nuevas alianzas

en.title: The Brazil that is coming: markets, investments and new alliances
en.summary: Regardless of election outcomes, Brazil's public finances, relationships with China, the United States and Europe, and investment regulations will determine opportunities and risks in Latin America's largest economy.

stories.title: Starbucks suma 57,200 coleccionables de Día de Muertos a la disputa por clientes con Tim Hortons

en.title: Starbucks adds 57,200 Day of the Dead collectibles to customer dispute with Tim Hortons
en.summary: Starbucks will launch seven new collectible designs themed around Day of the Dead three days after its previous promotion, extending its autumn collectibles calendar to compete with Tim Hortons.
